content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 69 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) posts are vacant, divided into Broad Specialty (42 posts) and Super Specialty (27 posts) departments. In case of non-availability of EWS candidates, the post shall be filled under the UR category. Unreserved category candidates can also apply against reserved posts; if considered due to unavailability of a reserved-category candidate, their engagement in such cases will be for a period of 44 days only from the date of joining. 4% of the total posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) (non-surgical jobs only) among Senior Resident posts.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the following essential qualifications to apply for the AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident (Non-Academic) walk-in interview. A medical qualification included in the first or second schedule, or Part II of the third schedule, of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956 (candidates with Part II third schedule qualifications must also fulfil the conditions of Section 13(3) of the Act). Must be registered with the Central/State Medical Council. A postgraduate degree, i.e., MD/MS/DNB as per MCI rule in the specialty concerned, or its equivalent from a recognized University/Institute. Candidates must hold a valid qualification (pass certificate) as on the last date for receipt of applications. For the departments below, candidates may apply through either the medical or the non-medical route. The prescribed qualification is the minimum requirement; merely possessing it does not entitle a candidate to selection. Only candidates who have been declared successful in their qualifying degree examination, and who will complete their tenure for the same on or before the crucial date, will be eligible.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview will be held at the Administrative Block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Bilaspur, Kothipura, Himachal Pradesh-174037. Candidates are required to report on or before 09:00 AM on 21.08.2026. Candidates must appear physically before the interview board; no request for an online interview will be entertained. Based on verification of original documents, the Screening Committee may shortlist candidates for interview. Only original certificates of candidates selected for the post of Senior Resident will be verified, including MBBS degree certificate, Internship Completion Certificate, qualifying degree certificate, Medical Registration Certificate, Date of Birth Certificate/10th Standard Certificate, Caste Certificate, and other relevant certificates.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Walk-in Interview Process
content_sections.text: Since this is a walk-in recruitment, candidates are NOT required to fill any online application form. The process to be followed is: Prepare a duly filled and signed original application form. Fill and keep ready Annexure-II (Proforma/Checklist for the post of Senior Resident), to be submitted during document verification before the interview. Carry one set of self-attested photocopies of Degrees, Certificates, Mark sheets, Age proof, Caste certificates, PwBD certificate (if applicable), and Publications (Pub-Med, Non-PubMed)/Awards, if any. Carry all original documents for verification at the time of the interview. Pay the application fee (if applicable) via NEFT and carry proof of payment. Report in person at the Recruitment Cell, 3rd Floor, Administrative Block, AIIMS Bilaspur, Kothipura, Himachal Pradesh, on or before 09:00 AM on 21.08.2026. Candidates working in Central/State Government, Semi-Government, or Autonomous Institutions must submit a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview, clearly stating they will be permitted to join AIIMS Bilaspur if selected; interview participation is allowed only on production of the original NOC.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Important Links
content_sections.text: Candidates holding a postgraduate medical degree can also explore more MD/MS/DNB Government Jobs and Senior Resident Jobs available across India. Applicants looking for opportunities in Himachal Pradesh can also check the latest Himachal Pradesh Government Jobs across various departments. Those searching for openings at other AIIMS institutes can browse more AIIMS Recruitment notifications, and non-medical postgraduates (M.Sc./Ph.D.) can explore additional Research Fellow Jobs and M.Sc Government Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment drive by AIIMS Bilaspur for 69 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) posts (42 Broad Specialty and 27 Super Specialty) across various medical departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 69 vacancies are available - 42 under Broad Specialty and 27 under Super Specialty departments.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an online application for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are not required to fill any online form. They must report in person with a duly filled application form and original documents at the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bilaspur.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 21.08.2026 (Friday). Candidates must report on or before 09:00 AM; those reporting after 10:00 AM will not be allowed.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates need a postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the relevant specialty from a recognized University/Institute, registered with the Central/State Medical Council. Select departments also accept non-medical candidates with M.Sc./M.Biotech plus Ph.D. qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the crucial date, with no age relaxation for reserved category candidates applying against unreserved vacancies.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- + 18% GST (Rs. 1180/- total), payable via NEFT. PwBD, SC, and ST candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident (Non-Academic)?
faq.answer: Medical candidates (MD/MS/DNB) get Level-11 pay with a minimum of Rs. 67,700/- plus NPA and allowances; non-medical candidates (M.Sc. with Ph.D.) get Level-10 pay with a minimum of Rs. 56,100/- plus allowances.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Bilaspur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview, preceded by document verification. Candidates must appear physically; no online interviews are entertained.

faq.answer: The interview will be held at the 3rd Floor, Administrative Block, AIIMS Bilaspur, Kothipura, Himachal Pradesh-174037.
